title: Fleet Comeback Labor Share by Age of the Original Repair — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Fleet warranty schedule — Service Accounts and Repair Orders.** On a commercial fleet account (Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30), the covered labor share of a comeback follows the age of the original repair.

| Whole months from the original repair's line date to the repeat labor charge's line date | Covered labor share |
|---|---|
| 9 or more | 0.7 |
| At least 6 and fewer than 9 | 0.8 |
| Fewer than 6 | the tier's comeback labor share; no change applies |

Whole months are counted from one date to another, a whole month being complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day.

**Edges (hypothetical dates).** Original repair 11 January:
- repeat on 10 July: 5 whole months, the tier's share;
- repeat on 11 July: 6 whole months, 0.8;
- repeat on 10 October: 8 whole months, 0.8;
- repeat on 11 October: 9 whole months, 0.7.
